name: Shikabane Kaibou Giga
source:
Shou lives to paint. He's not interested in anything except art and refuses to interact with people beyond necessity. One day, someone destroys Shou's paintings; the only thing he truly cares about.

But it doesn't stop there. Later, his girlfriend, Tsukiko, is raped.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ322759.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
寿为画而生。他对艺术以外的任何事情都不感兴趣，并且拒绝与人进行非必要的互动。一日，受人毁画；他唯一真正关心的事情。

但它并不止于此。后来，他的女友月子被强奸。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ322759.html]DLsite[/url]]
